settings.title: The Amber Nocturne
settings.lede: A night-blooming amber that lingers like the last light on the dunes.
settings.description: Glowing labdanum and golden resins warmed by Madagascan vanilla and a whisper of Cambodian oud — a skin scent for golden-hour souls.
settings.flacon: Hand-faceted crystal filled with honeyed amber, crowned with a polished gold sphere. Refillable.
settings.composition: Alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua, benzyl benzoate, limonene, linalool. 20% concentration.

settings.title: The Night Treasure
settings.lede: Oud Noir embodies a new facet of mystery — smoke, leather and black plum.
settings.description: Smouldering Assam agarwood wrapped in black leather, frankincense and dark plum — an extrait that lasts from midnight until dawn.
settings.flacon: Heavy black glass with a gold collar and a hand-knotted silk tassel atomiser.
settings.composition: Alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua, coumarin, eugenol. 25% concentration.

settings.title: The Dawn Rose
settings.lede: Taif roses gathered before sunrise, distilled the very same morning.
settings.description: Dewy, velvety and quietly romantic, with lychee brightness and a soft musk trail.
settings.flacon: Pebble-shaped crystal blushed with rose gold, finished with a faceted rose-gold cap.
settings.composition: Alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua, citronellol, geraniol. 18% concentration.

settings.title: The Saffron Veil
settings.lede: Radiant saffron draped over sun-warmed sandalwood.
settings.description: Kashmiri saffron and orange blossom over Mysore sandalwood — a luminous veil that glows like the desert at high noon.
settings.flacon: Slim ribbed crystal column with a polished gold dome.
settings.composition: Alcohol denat., parfum (fragrance), aqua, limonene, linalool. 20% concentration.

settings.title: Agarwood Oud
settings.text: Liquid gold of the East — resinous, smoky and impossibly deep. Aged for twelve years before distillation.

settings.title: Saffron
settings.text: Three crimson threads per flower, picked by hand at first light in late autumn.

settings.title: Taif Rose
settings.text: Thirty-petal damask roses distilled in copper the morning they are picked.

settings.title: Golden Amber
settings.text: Warm resins and labdanum melted slowly into a glowing, honeyed heart.
